dedupe_keys.name: noisecapture android environmental noise measurement app

description: NoiseCapture is an Android application that turns calibrated microphone observations into environmental sound indicators with geographic positions. UMRAE and Lab-STICC publish the Java source on GitHub under GPL version 3, with links to app distributions and the OnoMap spatial data service. The README describes one-second equivalent sound levels, frequency analysis, local statistics and optional sharing for community noise maps. Source access is free. Coverage follows the location and duration of each user measurement, not a fixed monitoring network. Microphone calibration, phone quality and GPS accuracy are limitations when comparing different devices or sites. Modellers could use the documented collection and GeoJSON export workflow to prepare observations for traffic-noise or urban-exposure simulation checks. data-bts-national-transportation-noise-map is a related modelled resource, without a verified import procedure. The former Ifsttar repository redirects to Université Gustave Eiffel. No application, audio recording or source archive was installed or downloaded.
